data.claim: Silent displacement is structurally impossible if the workspace is replaced by a Merkle-DAG of pending side effects where completed evidence is defined as a content-addressed node replicated to a threshold of anchor nodes; reclamation is merely garbage collection of unreached leaves. The workspace is modeled as an append-only causal log of deterministic transformations, each yielding a content-addressed node. Evidence completion is the act of linking the evidence node to the problem trunk and achieving a threshold of anti-entropy anchors. The protocol durably records only the problem trunk root hash and the anchor node IDs. Crash recovery replays from the trunk root. Reclamation removes only orphan nodes that are not linked to any trunk, which by construction excludes all completed evidence.
